senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. (v. סְלִיק) Seleucia, the great city and fortress of Syria founded by Seleucus Nicator.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 9">Midr. Till. to Ps. IX</cite> ed. Bub. <he>סלייקוס בנה ס׳</he> Seleucus built Seleucia; Yalk. ib. 642 <he>סולקוס בנה ס׳</he> (not <he>סליקוא</he>); [Midr. Till. ed. Bub. l. c. <he>סקילוס בנה סקיליא</he>, a corrupt Var. lect. of our wds.; oth. ed. contain only the corrupt version, some having <cite ref="O00809"><he>סיציליא</he></cite>].
